name: Royal Marmalade
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Cut each orange into eight quarters and slice them very fine.
Take out the seeds and put them into a basin and cover with water.
To every pound of fruit add three pints of cold water.
Let it stand for twenty-four hours, then boil until tender.
Put the juice from the seeds in also.
Let it stand until the following day.
To every pound of boiled fruit add one and a half pounds of sugar and the rind and juice of two lemons.
Boil, stirring constantly until the syrup jellies.

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Cut each orange into eight quarters and slice them very fine.
2. Take out the seeds and put them into a basin and cover with water.
3. To every pound of fruit add three pints of cold water.
4. Let it stand for twenty-four hours, then boil until tender.
5. Put the juice from the seeds in also.
6. Let it stand until the following day.
7. To every pound of boiled fruit add one and a half pounds of sugar and the rind and juice of two lemons.
8. Boil, stirring constantly until the syrup jellies.
